newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels sees hotel buys helping.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels sees hotel buys helping.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Inc said Tuesday that hotel acquisitions it made in the third quarter should boost future earnings.
During the quarter the company completed seven hotel acquisitions, consisting of a total of 1,629 rooms, increasing the number of hotels it owns to 21.
The acquisitions "will help contribute to future earnings growth in the quarters ahead," Chief Executive W. Thomas Parrington said in a statement.

As a result of the accelerated pace of acquisitions, Interstate has increased its debt capacity by $400 million. It did so by converting existing acquisition debt of $100 million to a term loan, increasing availability of funds under the company's acquisition facility to $200 million from $100 million, and modifying its credit facilities to permit an additional $200 million of debt from third parties.
